table:acceptance_decisions:CREATE TABLE acceptance_decisions (

 issue_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
 issue_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 parent_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 revision TEXT NOT NULL,
 snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,
 frozen_body TEXT NOT NULL,
 findings_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 accepted INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(accepted IN (0,1)),
 comment_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 projected INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(projected IN (0,1)),
 delivered INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(delivered IN (0,1)),
 diagnostic TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 exception_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 UNIQUE(run_id,story_key,exception_id)
)

 UNIQUE(owner_id,owner_generation,repository_ref,task_ref,operation,request_key)
)

)

)

table:application_result_aggregate_checks:CREATE TABLE application_result_aggregate_checks (
 result_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 aggregate_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 reference TEXT NOT NULL,
 execution_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 run_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 attempt TEXT NOT NULL,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind='aggregate'),
 name TEXT NOT NULL,
 digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 executed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(executed IN (0,1)),
 passed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(passed IN (0,1)),
 evidence TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(result_id,reference),
 UNIQUE(run_id,execution_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(result_id,aggregate_ref) REFERENCES application_result_aggregates(result_id,reference),
 FOREIGN KEY(run_id,attempt) REFERENCES application_result_attempts(run_id,attempt)
)

table:application_result_aggregates:CREATE TABLE application_result_aggregates (
 result_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES application_results(id),
 reference TEXT NOT NULL,
 run_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 attempt TEXT NOT NULL,
 parent_task TEXT NOT NULL,
 context_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 selected BLOB NOT NULL,
 selected_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 files BLOB NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(result_id,reference),
 FOREIGN KEY(run_id,attempt) REFERENCES application_result_attempts(run_id,attempt)
)

table:application_result_attempts:CREATE TABLE application_result_attempts (
 judge_attempt_id TEXT REFERENCES judge_attempts(id), doctor_attempt_id TEXT REFERENCES doctor_attempts(id),
 run_id INTEGER REFERENCES runs(id),
 attempt TEXT NOT NULL,
 result_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES application_results(id),
 active INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(active IN (0,1)),
 PRIMARY KEY(run_id,attempt)
,
 CHECK((run_id IS NOT NULL AND doctor_attempt_id IS NULL AND judge_attempt_id IS NULL) OR (run_id IS NULL AND doctor_attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND judge_attempt_id IS NULL) OR (run_id IS NULL AND doctor_attempt_id IS NULL AND judge_attempt_id IS NOT NULL))
)

table:application_result_observations:CREATE TABLE application_result_observations (
 judge_attempt_id TEXT REFERENCES judge_attempts(id), doctor_attempt_id TEXT REFERENCES doctor_attempts(id),
 request_row INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES application_result_requests(id),
 sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence>=1),
 run_id INTEGER,
 attempt TEXT NOT NULL,
 dimension TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(request_row,sequence),
 FOREIGN KEY(run_id,attempt) REFERENCES application_result_attempts(run_id,attempt)
,
 CHECK((run_id IS NOT NULL AND doctor_attempt_id IS NULL AND judge_attempt_id IS NULL) OR (run_id IS NULL AND doctor_attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND judge_attempt_id IS NULL) OR (run_id IS NULL AND doctor_attempt_id IS NULL AND judge_attempt_id IS NOT NULL))
)

table:application_result_requests:CREATE TABLE application_result_requests (
 judge_attempt_id TEXT REFERENCES judge_attempts(id), doctor_attempt_id TEXT REFERENCES doctor_attempts(id),
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 result_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES application_results(id),
 run_id INTEGER,
 attempt TEXT NOT NULL,
 request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 payload BLOB NOT NULL,
 diagnostics BLOB NOT NULL,
 input_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(input_state IN ('accepted','rejected')),
 applied_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(applied_revision>=0),
 submission_receipt_id INTEGER REFERENCES submission_receipts(id),
 UNIQUE(run_id,request_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(run_id,attempt) REFERENCES application_result_attempts(run_id,attempt)
,
 CHECK((run_id IS NOT NULL AND doctor_attempt_id IS NULL AND judge_attempt_id IS NULL) OR (run_id IS NULL AND doctor_attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND judge_attempt_id IS NULL) OR (run_id IS NULL AND doctor_attempt_id IS NULL AND judge_attempt_id IS NOT NULL))
)

table:application_result_revisions:CREATE TABLE application_result_revisions (
 judge_attempt_id TEXT REFERENCES judge_attempts(id), doctor_attempt_id TEXT REFERENCES doctor_attempts(id),
 result_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES application_results(id),
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>=1),
 run_id INTEGER,
 attempt TEXT NOT NULL,
 request_row INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES application_result_requests(id),
 snapshot BLOB NOT NULL,
 snapshot_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 retired BLOB NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(result_id,revision),
 FOREIGN KEY(run_id,attempt) REFERENCES application_result_attempts(run_id,attempt)
,
 CHECK((run_id IS NOT NULL AND doctor_attempt_id IS NULL AND judge_attempt_id IS NULL) OR (run_id IS NULL AND doctor_attempt_id IS NOT NULL AND judge_attempt_id IS NULL) OR (run_id IS NULL AND doctor_attempt_id IS NULL AND judge_attempt_id IS NOT NULL))
)

table:application_results:CREATE TABLE application_results (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 task TEXT NOT NULL,
 mode TEXT NOT NULL,
 work_context TEXT NOT NULL,
 context_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(schema_version=1),
 workflow_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(workflow_version IN (1,2)),
 submission_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(submission_version=2),
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(revision>=0),
 workflow TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 CHECK((workflow='' AND mode IN ('research','plan','implement','validate','spike')) OR (workflow IN ('bug','doctor') AND mode='') OR (workflow='judge' AND mode='judge')),
 UNIQUE(task,mode,context_hash)
)

table:approved_story_revisions:CREATE TABLE approved_story_revisions (

 parent_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(parent_id > 0),

 body TEXT NOT NULL,
 digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL, sizing_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

 FOREIGN KEY(parent_task,generation,story_key) REFERENCES managed_stories(parent_task,generation,story_key)
)

table:brainstorm_drafts:CREATE TABLE brainstorm_drafts (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, draft_set_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES brainstorm_draft_sets(id), key TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
 title TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(title AS BLOB))<=256), size TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(size IN ('S','M','L')), impact TEXT NOT NULL,
 related_issues TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', duplicate_warning TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', search_hits TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 ledger TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(draft_set_id,key), UNIQUE(draft_set_id,ordinal)
)

table:brainstorm_entries:CREATE TABLE brainstorm_entries (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, brainstorm_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES brainstorms(id), seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('idea','decision','open_question','related_issue','document_note','exchange')),
 text TEXT NOT NULL, document_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', issue_reference TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', scan_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 request_key TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 CHECK((kind='document_note') = (document_name<>'')),
 UNIQUE(brainstorm_id,seq), UNIQUE(brainstorm_id,request_key)
)

table:brainstorm_plan_launch_seeds:CREATE TABLE brainstorm_plan_launch_seeds (
 launch_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 attempt_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 ledger_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 brief_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 technical_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 session_dir TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(state IN ('pending','writing','complete','skipped_existing')),
 reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 completed_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:brainstorm_scan_receipts:CREATE TABLE brainstorm_scan_receipts (
 scan_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES brainstorm_scans(id),
 execution_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES brainstorm_scans(execution_id),
 request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 payload TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:brainstorm_scans:CREATE TABLE brainstorm_scans (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, brainstorm_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES brainstorms(id), scan_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
 owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL, owner_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, repository_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 request_key TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL, question TEXT NOT NULL,
 team_version TEXT NOT NULL, team_files TEXT NOT NULL,
 basis_commit TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', grant_id TEXT NOT NULL, consent_revision TEXT NOT NULL,
 job_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, execution_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 answer TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', research TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', questions TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
 usage TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', cost TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', failure_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 exchange_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', purpose TEXT CHECK(purpose IS NULL OR purpose IN ('question','drafts')),
 UNIQUE(brainstorm_id,scan_seq), UNIQUE(brainstorm_id,request_key)
)

table:brainstorm_task_batches:CREATE TABLE brainstorm_task_batches (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_action_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', execution_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, owner_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, repository_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 repository_ref TEXT NOT NULL, brainstorm_id TEXT NOT NULL, draft_set_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('running','settled')),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, settled_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

table:brainstorm_task_continuations:CREATE TABLE brainstorm_task_continuations (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, batch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES brainstorm_task_batches(id),
 execution_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('create','continue','recreate')),
 items TEXT NOT NULL, frozen_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('running','settled')),
 summary_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(summary_state IN ('pending','sent','no_channel')),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, settled_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

table:brainstorm_task_items:CREATE TABLE brainstorm_task_items (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, batch_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES brainstorm_task_batches(id),
 draft_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 title TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, marker TEXT NOT NULL,
 ledger TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', ledger_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','creating','uncertain','uncertain_exhausted','not_created','created','plan_starting','plan_started','plan_start_failed')),
 issue_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, issue_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, issue_link TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 session_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, attempt_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', checks_done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 next_check_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', create_retries INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 failed_launch_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(batch_id, ordinal)
)

table:brainstorm_task_launch_attempts:CREATE TABLE brainstorm_task_launch_attempts (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
 session_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','reserved','running','succeeded','failed')),
 run_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 outcome TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(outcome IN ('','replayed','deferred','failed','started')),
 reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(item_id, ordinal)
)

table:brainstorms:CREATE TABLE brainstorms (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL, owner_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, repository_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('open','closed')),
 close_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(close_reason IN ('','owner','expired')),
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, next_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, next_scan_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 grant_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT NOT NULL, last_activity_at TEXT NOT NULL, closed_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

table:bug_analyses:CREATE TABLE bug_analyses (
 session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bug_tasks(session_id),
 invocation TEXT NOT NULL,
 input_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(input_digest)=64),
 ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND 8),
 graph_attempt_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES graph_node_attempts(id),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('reserved','dispatched','succeeded','failed','cancelled','uncertain')),
 run_id INTEGER REFERENCES runs(id),
 pass_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 revision INTEGER,
 digest TEXT,
 content BLOB CHECK(content IS NULL OR length(content)<=1048576),
 review_ready INTEGER CHECK(review_ready IN (0,1)),
 response TEXT CHECK(response IN ('ask','done','blocked')),
 reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 evidence BLOB,
 operation TEXT,
 revision_input_digest TEXT,
 result_id INTEGER,
 result_revision INTEGER,
 review TEXT,
 review_delivery_key TEXT,
 review_content_digest TEXT,
 review_comment_id INTEGER,
 review_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(review_active IN (0,1)),
 approval_reply_id INTEGER,
 approval_owner_id INTEGER,
 approval_approved_at TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(session_id,invocation),
 UNIQUE(session_id,ordinal),
 UNIQUE(graph_attempt_id),
 UNIQUE(session_id,revision),
 UNIQUE(session_id,operation),
 UNIQUE(session_id,review),
 UNIQUE(review_delivery_key),
 UNIQUE(session_id,approval_reply_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(result_id,result_revision) REFERENCES application_result_revisions(result_id,revision)
)

table:bug_checks:CREATE TABLE bug_checks (
 session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bug_tasks(session_id),
 operation TEXT NOT NULL,
 input_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 binding BLOB NOT NULL,
 recipe BLOB NOT NULL,
 command_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(command_count BETWEEN 1 AND 64),
 commands BLOB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
 outcome TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
 reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 cancelled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(cancelled IN (0,1)),
 cleanup INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(cleanup IN (0,1)),
 current INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(current IN (0,1)),
 unreliable INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(unreliable IN (0,1)),
 source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'factory',
 repair TEXT,
 generation TEXT,
 phase TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(session_id,operation)
)

table:bug_delivery:CREATE TABLE bug_delivery (
 session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES bug_tasks(session_id),
 pr_operation TEXT NOT NULL,
 pr_input_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 pr_branch TEXT NOT NULL,
 pr_creator_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 pr_marker TEXT NOT NULL,
 pr_dispatched INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(pr_dispatched IN (0,1)),
 pr_cancelled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(pr_cancelled IN (0,1)),
 pr BLOB,
 review_digest TEXT,
 review_evidence BLOB,
 review_pr BLOB,
 review_presentation BLOB,
 review_body TEXT,
 review_content_digest TEXT,
 review_delivery_key TEXT,
 review_bot_id INTEGER,
 review_comment_id INTEGER,
 review_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(review_active IN (0,1)),
 review_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 approval_comment_id INTEGER,
 approval_owner_id INTEGER,
 approval_digest TEXT,
 approval_body TEXT,
 approval_at TEXT,
 merge_operation TEXT,
 merge_review_digest TEXT,
 merge_binding BLOB,
 merge_dispatched INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(merge_dispatched IN (0,1)),
 merge_outcome TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
 merge_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 merge_exception TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 merge_retry_continuation TEXT,
 merge_retry_evidence TEXT,
 close_operation TEXT,
 close_merge_operation TEXT,
 close_endpoint TEXT,
 close_binding BLOB,
 close_dispatched INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(close_dispatched IN (0,1)),
 close_confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(close_confirmed IN (0,1)),
 close_outcome TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
 close_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 close_conflict INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(close_conflict IN (0,1)),
 close_retry_continuation TEXT,
 close_retry_evidence TEXT,
 UNIQUE(review_delivery_key)
)

table:bug_events:CREATE TABLE bug_events (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bug_tasks(session_id),
 kind TEXT NOT NULL,
 reference TEXT NOT NULL,
 attempt_id INTEGER REFERENCES graph_node_attempts(id),
 delivery_key TEXT,
 content BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(content)<=1048576),
 reported INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(reported IN (0,1)),
 recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(session_id,kind,reference),
 UNIQUE(delivery_key)
)

table:bug_filing_start_attempts:CREATE TABLE bug_filing_start_attempts (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 filing_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bug_filings(id),
 ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
 session_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','reserved','running','succeeded','failed')),
 run_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 outcome TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(outcome IN ('','replayed','deferred','failed','started')),
 reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(filing_id, ordinal)
)

table:bug_filings:CREATE TABLE bug_filings (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
 execution_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 owner_action_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 owner_generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
 repository_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 repository_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 title TEXT NOT NULL,
 body TEXT NOT NULL,
 marker TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('admitted','creating','uncertain','created','labelled','start_admitted','dispatched','not_created','failed_unconfirmed','label_failed','start_failed')),
 issue_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 issue_node_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 issue_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 issue_link TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 session_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 attempt_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 checks_done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 next_check_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 create_retries INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 label_retries INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 failed_start_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 admission_trigger INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:bug_repairs:CREATE TABLE bug_repairs (
 session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES bug_tasks(session_id),
 request TEXT NOT NULL,
 input_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal>=1),
 analysis_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
 analysis_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 approval_review TEXT NOT NULL,
 cause TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(cause IN ('initial','test_failure','pr_feedback','reshape')),
 evidence TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_commit TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_tree TEXT NOT NULL,
 graph_attempt_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES graph_node_attempts(id),
 run_id INTEGER REFERENCES runs(id),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('reserved','dispatched','completed','reshape','blocked','failed','uncertain')),
 reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 result_id INTEGER,
 result_revision INTEGER,
 completion_evidence BLOB,
 completed_commit TEXT,
 completed_tree TEXT,
 save_operation TEXT,
 scope_source_commit TEXT,
 scope_source_tree TEXT,
 scope_diff_digest TEXT,
 scope_disposition TEXT CHECK(scope_disposition IN ('within','outside','indeterminate')),
 scope_evidence TEXT,
 scope_paths BLOB,
 test_operation TEXT,
 test_input_digest TEXT,
 test_binding BLOB,
 test_generation INTEGER,
 test_parent_instance INTEGER REFERENCES graph_instances(id),
 test_parent_attempt INTEGER REFERENCES graph_node_attempts(id),
 test_child_instance INTEGER REFERENCES graph_instances(id),
 test_definition_digest TEXT,
 test_outcome TEXT CHECK(test_outcome IN ('pending','passed','failed','blocked','cancelled')),
 test_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 test_cancelled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(test_cancelled IN (0,1)),
 test_consumed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(test_consumed IN (0,1)),
 test_current INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(test_current IN (0,1)),
 test_created_at TEXT,
 grant_reference TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(session_id,request),
 UNIQUE(session_id,ordinal),
 UNIQUE(session_id,test_operation),
 UNIQUE(test_parent_attempt),
 UNIQUE(test_child_instance),
 UNIQUE(grant_reference)
)

table:bug_tasks:CREATE TABLE bug_tasks (
 session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES workflow_admissions(session_id),
 repository TEXT NOT NULL,
 issue_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(issue_id>0),
 issue_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(issue_number>0),
 owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(owner_id>0),
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(revision>=1),
 current_analysis INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(current_analysis>=0),
 analysis_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(analysis_used BETWEEN 0 AND 8),
 parent_instance INTEGER REFERENCES graph_instances(id),
 parent_definition INTEGER REFERENCES graph_definitions(id),
 child_definition INTEGER REFERENCES graph_definitions(id),
 disposition TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running',
 node TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'record',
 reference TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 cancelled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(cancelled IN (0,1)),
 guard_owner TEXT,
 guard_kind TEXT CHECK(guard_kind IN ('repair','checks','child','save')),
 CHECK((guard_owner IS NULL)=(guard_kind IS NULL)),
 CHECK((parent_instance IS NULL)=(parent_definition IS NULL) AND (parent_instance IS NULL)=(child_definition IS NULL))
)

table:chat_conversation_actions:CREATE TABLE chat_conversation_actions (
 turn_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES chat_conversation_turns(id), dialogue_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 dialogue_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, execution_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', preview_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 payload_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', outcome TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

table:chat_conversation_answer_parts:CREATE TABLE chat_conversation_answer_parts (
 answer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_conversation_answers(id), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
 transport TEXT NOT NULL, reply_id TEXT NOT NULL, discord_message_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 acknowledged_at TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(answer_id,ordinal), UNIQUE(transport,reply_id)
)

table:chat_conversation_answers:CREATE TABLE chat_conversation_answers (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, turn_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES chat_conversation_turns(id),
 transport TEXT NOT NULL, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, channel_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 blocks TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, proposal_part INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, completed_at TEXT, expired_at TEXT
)

table:chat_conversation_details:CREATE TABLE chat_conversation_details (
 transport TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, answer_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', paused INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 PRIMARY KEY(transport,request_id)
)

table:chat_conversation_details_parts:CREATE TABLE chat_conversation_details_parts (
 transport TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, reply_id TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
 acknowledged_at TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(transport,request_id,ordinal), UNIQUE(transport,reply_id)
)

table:chat_conversation_evidence:CREATE TABLE chat_conversation_evidence (
 turn_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_conversation_turns(id),
 ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
 source_turn_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_conversation_turns(id),
 repository TEXT NOT NULL, issue TEXT NOT NULL,
 metadata BLOB NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL,
 purged INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 PRIMARY KEY(turn_id,ordinal)
)

table:chat_conversation_exchanges:CREATE TABLE chat_conversation_exchanges (
 turn_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_conversation_turns(id), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND 16),
 kind TEXT NOT NULL, request TEXT NOT NULL, result TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', provider_attempt TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 captured_at TEXT NOT NULL, complete INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, gaps TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 PRIMARY KEY(turn_id,ordinal)
)

table:chat_conversation_instructions:CREATE TABLE chat_conversation_instructions (
 conversation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES chat_conversations(id),
 capture BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(capture)>0 AND length(capture)<=16777216),
 legacy_baseline INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(legacy_baseline IN (0,1)),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:chat_conversation_references:CREATE TABLE chat_conversation_references (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, turn_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_conversation_turns(id),
 kind TEXT NOT NULL, repository TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', target TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', revision TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 content TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', expires_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:chat_conversation_turns:CREATE TABLE chat_conversation_turns (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_conversations(id),
 source_id TEXT NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, prompt TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(state IN ('pending','running','completed','interrupted','unavailable')),
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, worker TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', lease_until TEXT,
 reply_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', delivered_at TEXT, discord_message_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT, source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', reply_to TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 UNIQUE(conversation_id,source_id), UNIQUE(conversation_id,sequence)
)

table:chat_conversations:CREATE TABLE chat_conversations (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, transport TEXT NOT NULL, channel_ref TEXT NOT NULL, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 name TEXT NOT NULL, provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(provider IN ('claude','codex')),
 session_handle TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', state_dir TEXT NOT NULL,
 active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, delivery_paused INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, health_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, next_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
, fresh_after INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

table:chat_inbox:CREATE TABLE "chat_inbox" (
 transport TEXT NOT NULL, message_id TEXT NOT NULL, channel_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 target_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 command TEXT NOT NULL, arguments TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('working','answering','pending','sent','confirmed','failed')),
 attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, next_attempt_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 reply_text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 finished_at TEXT, last_error_at TEXT,
 question TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(length(CAST(question AS BLOB))<=8192),
 project_option TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', resolved_repo_id INTEGER REFERENCES repos(id),
 answer_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(answer_attempts BETWEEN 0 AND 2), presentation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(presentation_state IN ('','pending','narrated','raw_fallback','inline')), presentation_outcome TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(length(CAST(presentation_outcome AS BLOB))<=262144), presentation_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(presentation_generation IN (0,1)), presentation_check INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(presentation_check IN (0,1)), reply_attachment TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(length(CAST(reply_attachment AS BLOB))<=65536), outcome_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(outcome_status IN ('','success','refusal','error','uncertain')), conversation_turn_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 PRIMARY KEY(transport,message_id)
)

table:chat_issue_previews:CREATE TABLE chat_issue_previews (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, transport TEXT NOT NULL, channel_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 repo_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES repos(id), source_message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 code TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('previewed','superseded','creating','uncertain','created','expired')),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, last_attempt_at TEXT,
 last_confirm_message_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', claim_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, lease_until TEXT,
 issue_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, issue_link TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', finished_at TEXT,
 UNIQUE(transport,source_message_id)
)

table:chat_natural_dialogues:CREATE TABLE chat_natural_dialogues (
 transport TEXT NOT NULL, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, channel_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 payload TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL, code TEXT NOT NULL,
 prompt_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(transport,owner_id,channel_ref)
)

table:chat_natural_executions:CREATE TABLE chat_natural_executions (
 identity TEXT PRIMARY KEY, transport TEXT NOT NULL, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, channel_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'authorized',
 outcome TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT NOT NULL, finished_at TEXT,
 UNIQUE(transport,owner_id,channel_ref,revision)
)

table:chat_natural_messages:CREATE TABLE chat_natural_messages (
 channel_ref TEXT NOT NULL, source_id TEXT NOT NULL, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 reply_to TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', content TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'staged', finished_at TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(channel_ref,source_id)
)

table:chat_notice_positions:CREATE TABLE chat_notice_positions (
 transport TEXT NOT NULL,
 source TEXT NOT NULL,
 last_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 initial_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 initial_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 seen TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
 pending TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 PRIMARY KEY(transport,source)
)

table:chat_notices:CREATE TABLE chat_notices (
 transport TEXT NOT NULL,
 message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 channel_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 command TEXT NOT NULL,
 task_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 arguments TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','sent','confirmed','failed')),
 attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 next_attempt_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 reply_text TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 finished_at TEXT,
 last_error_at TEXT,
 PRIMARY KEY(transport,message_id)
)

table:chat_presentation_owners:CREATE TABLE chat_presentation_owners (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
 repo_id INTEGER REFERENCES repos(id),
 phase TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(phase IN ('generation','checking'))
)

table:ci_transport:CREATE TABLE ci_transport (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    not_before TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    provenance TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    lease TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    lease_until TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

table:comment_operations:CREATE TABLE comment_operations (
 run_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 attempt TEXT NOT NULL,
 request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 repository TEXT NOT NULL,
 task TEXT NOT NULL,
 issue_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(issue_number > 0),
 bot_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(bot_id > 0),
 body TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('uncertain','confirmed')),
 comment_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 PRIMARY KEY(run_id, attempt, request_id)
)

table:comments:CREATE TABLE comments (
    id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    session_id       INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    forge_comment_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    author_handle    TEXT    NOT NULL,
    author_user_id   INTEGER,            -- durable identity behind the renameable handle (D-I)
    author_is_bot    INTEGER NOT NULL,   -- 0/1, as the forge reported it
    body             TEXT    NOT NULL,   -- verbatim, unredacted
    created_at       TEXT    NOT NULL,   -- the forge's timestamp, not ours
    classification   TEXT    NOT NULL,   -- instruction | third_party | self
    tag              TEXT,               -- c1, c2, … assigned to third_party only
    recorded_at      TEXT    NOT NULL, reply_to_comment_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(reply_to_comment_id>=0),
    UNIQUE (session_id, forge_comment_id)
)

table:conflict_proposal_files:CREATE TABLE conflict_proposal_files (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    proposal_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES conflict_proposals (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    ordinal     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    path        TEXT NOT NULL,
    resolution  TEXT NOT NULL, details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    UNIQUE (proposal_id, ordinal)
)

table:conflict_proposals:CREATE TABLE conflict_proposals (
    id                 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    session_id         INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    trigger_comment_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    model              TEXT NOT NULL,
    status             TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    resolved_at        TEXT, base_sha TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', branch_sha TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', confirmed_by TEXT, confirmed_comment_id INTEGER, applied_commit_sha TEXT, applied_at TEXT, format INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, inputs TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}' CHECK (length(inputs) <= 8192),
    -- One session may have at most one durable proposal per triggering
    -- comment; replaying the same blocked-run trigger returns the original
    -- proposal rather than creating a second one, the same replay guarantee
    -- schedule_proposals gives on (session_id, source_comment_id).
    UNIQUE (session_id, trigger_comment_id)
)

table:connector_access:CREATE TABLE connector_access (
 digest TEXT PRIMARY KEY, grant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES connector_grants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, revoked_at TEXT
)

table:connector_browsers:CREATE TABLE connector_browsers (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, client_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES connector_clients(id),
 redirect_uri TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, resource TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL,
 pkce_challenge TEXT NOT NULL, nonce_digest TEXT NOT NULL, upstream_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL, verified INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:connector_clients:CREATE TABLE connector_clients (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, auth_method TEXT NOT NULL,
 secret_digest TEXT NOT NULL, redirects TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:connector_codes:CREATE TABLE connector_codes (
 digest TEXT PRIMARY KEY, grant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES connector_grants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 client_id TEXT NOT NULL, redirect_uri TEXT NOT NULL, resource TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL,
 pkce_challenge TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, consumed_at TEXT
)

table:connector_grant_action_repositories:CREATE TABLE connector_grant_action_repositories (
 grant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES connector_grants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 repo_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES repos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 repository_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(grant_id,repo_id)
)

table:connector_grant_repositories:CREATE TABLE connector_grant_repositories (
 grant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES connector_grants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 repo_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES repos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 repository_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(grant_id,repo_id)
)

table:connector_grants:CREATE TABLE connector_grants (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, client_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES connector_clients(id),
 resource TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, revoked_at TEXT, reason TEXT,
 coverage_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
, all_repositories INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(all_repositories IN (0,1)))

table:connector_refresh:CREATE TABLE connector_refresh (
 digest TEXT PRIMARY KEY, grant_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES connector_grants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 parent_digest TEXT REFERENCES connector_refresh(digest), successor_digest TEXT,
 consumed_at TEXT, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:creation_owner_artifacts:CREATE TABLE creation_owner_artifacts (
 intent_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES creation_owner_publications(intent_id),
 ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal BETWEEN 0 AND 4),
 issue_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 issue_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 relationship TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(relationship IN ('pending','uncertain','linked','attached')),
 PRIMARY KEY(intent_id,ordinal)
)

table:creation_owner_publications:CREATE TABLE creation_owner_publications (
 intent_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES mcp_creation_intents(id),
 repository TEXT NOT NULL,
 proposal_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mcp_creation_proposals(hash),
 artifacts INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(artifacts BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('dispatched','confirmed','uncertain','refused')),
 reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 confirmed_ns INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 created_ns INTEGER NOT NULL
)

table:creation_preparations:CREATE TABLE creation_preparations (
 session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id),
 comment_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(comment_id > 0),
 owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(owner_id > 0),
 proposal_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mcp_creation_proposals(hash),
 PRIMARY KEY(session_id,comment_id)
)

table:creation_publication_artifacts:CREATE TABLE creation_publication_artifacts (
 operation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES mcp_creation_operations(id),
 ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal BETWEEN 0 AND 4),
 dispatched INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(dispatched IN (0,1)),
 issue_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 issue_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 relationship TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(relationship IN ('pending','uncertain','linked','attached')),
 PRIMARY KEY(operation_id,ordinal)
)

table:creation_publication_requests:CREATE TABLE creation_publication_requests (
 run_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 attempt TEXT NOT NULL,
 request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 operation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES mcp_creation_operations(id),
 PRIMARY KEY(run_id,attempt,request_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(run_id,attempt,request_id) REFERENCES family_requests(run_id,attempt,request_id)
)

table:creation_rejections:CREATE TABLE creation_rejections (
 session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id),
 comment_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(comment_id > 0),
 repository TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_task TEXT NOT NULL,
 command_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(command_kind IN ('approval','preparation')),
 reason TEXT NOT NULL,
 delivery BLOB NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(session_id,comment_id)
)

table:daemon_listener_status:CREATE TABLE daemon_listener_status (
    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
    listen_address    TEXT NOT NULL,
    listening         INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (listening IN (0, 1)),
    daemon_started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    written_at        TEXT NOT NULL
, last_heartbeat_started_at TEXT, discovery_paused INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (discovery_paused IN (0, 1)), pause_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', paused_since TEXT, expected_resume_at TEXT, runs_in_flight INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, chat_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', in_flight_sessions TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', slots_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, slots_total INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, runs_held TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', disk_status BLOB)

table:delivery_code_authorities:CREATE TABLE delivery_code_authorities (
 session_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES sessions(id),
 code_version_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES project_connection_versions(id),
 api_origin TEXT NOT NULL,
 repository TEXT NOT NULL,
 repository_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(owner_id>0),
 publisher_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(publisher_id>0 AND publisher_id<>owner_id)
)

table:delivery_control_sources:CREATE TABLE delivery_control_sources (
 source_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES delivery_code_authorities(session_id),
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('github-cli-request','github-pr-comment')),
 proposal_key TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation>0),
 actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(actor_id>0),
 comment_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 body TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 completed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(completed IN (0,1)),
 CHECK((kind='github-cli-request' AND comment_id=0 AND proposal_key='') OR
       (kind='github-pr-comment' AND comment_id>0 AND proposal_key<>''))
)

table:delivery_pr_bindings:CREATE TABLE delivery_pr_bindings (
 proposal_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES delivery_proposals(proposal_key),
 session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES delivery_code_authorities(session_id),
 pr_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(pr_id>0),
 pr_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(pr_number>0),
 enrolled_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:delivery_proposals:CREATE TABLE delivery_proposals (
 proposal_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, parent_task TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
 parent_id INTEGER NOT NULL, branch TEXT NOT NULL, head TEXT NOT NULL, target TEXT NOT NULL,
 readiness TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL,
 pr_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, pr_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 create_attempted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, proposed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 approval_comment INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 merge_attempted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, merge_confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 merge_sha TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', close_attempted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 closed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reported INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 superseded INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, diagnostic TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
, approval_source_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

table:delivery_readiness:CREATE TABLE delivery_readiness (
 record_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, parent_task TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
 full_report TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:discussion_conclusions:CREATE TABLE discussion_conclusions (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES task_discussions(id),
 owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL, owner_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, repository_ref TEXT NOT NULL, task_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 conclusion_key TEXT NOT NULL, digest TEXT NOT NULL, summary TEXT NOT NULL, rendered TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_job TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', grant_id TEXT NOT NULL, consent_revision TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('pending','sending','delivered','failed','uncertain')),
 reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', comment_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, next_attempt_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 UNIQUE(owner_id,owner_generation,repository_ref,task_ref,conversation_id,conclusion_key)
)

table:doctor_attempts:CREATE TABLE doctor_attempts (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES doctor_conversations(id),
 source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 owner_text TEXT NOT NULL,
 provider TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 configured_model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 observed_model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 prompt_version TEXT NOT NULL,
 guide_version TEXT NOT NULL,
 evidence TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('running','failed','interrupted','completed')),
 failure TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 finished_at TEXT
)

table:doctor_command_sources:CREATE TABLE doctor_command_sources (
 command_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES doctor_inbox(id),
 connection_version_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES project_connection_versions(id),
 publisher_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(publisher_id>0),
 provider TEXT NOT NULL, api_origin TEXT NOT NULL, remote_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 container TEXT NOT NULL, locator_key TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:doctor_conversations:CREATE TABLE doctor_conversations (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 task_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(generation > 0),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('active','stopped')),
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, current_proposal_id INTEGER REFERENCES doctor_proposals(id), current_result_id INTEGER REFERENCES application_results(id), current_result_revision INTEGER,
 UNIQUE(task_ref,generation)
)

table:doctor_inbox:CREATE TABLE doctor_inbox (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 repo_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES repos(id),
 task_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 issue_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(issue_id>0),
 issue_number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(issue_number>0),
 comment_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(comment_id>0),
 actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(actor_id>0),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(operation IN ('diagnose','stop','apply','usage')),
 instructions TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('queued','claimed','completed','stopped')) DEFAULT 'queued',
 claim_owner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(attempts BETWEEN 0 AND 2),
 result_body TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 conversation_id INTEGER REFERENCES doctor_conversations(id),
 proposal_id INTEGER REFERENCES doctor_proposals(id),
 UNIQUE(repo_id,comment_id)
)

table:doctor_instruction_captures:CREATE TABLE doctor_instruction_captures (
    attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES doctor_attempts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    capture BLOB NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:doctor_local_presentations:CREATE TABLE doctor_local_presentations (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 proposal_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES doctor_proposals(id),
 task_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
 digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 presented_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:doctor_presentations:CREATE TABLE doctor_presentations (
 command_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES doctor_inbox(id),
 proposal_id INTEGER REFERENCES doctor_proposals(id),
 entry_point TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(entry_point='github'),
 part INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(part>0),
 total INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(total>=part),
 delivery_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES report_deliveries(delivery_key),
 PRIMARY KEY(command_id,part)
)

table:doctor_proposals:CREATE TABLE doctor_proposals (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES doctor_conversations(id),
 attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES doctor_attempts(id),
 result_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
 result_revision INTEGER NOT NULL,
 payload BLOB NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(result_id,result_revision),
 FOREIGN KEY(result_id,result_revision) REFERENCES application_result_revisions(result_id,revision)
)

table:doctor_repair_holds:CREATE TABLE doctor_repair_holds (
 task_ref TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 repair_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES doctor_repairs(id),
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
 active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(active IN(0,1))
)

table:doctor_repair_steps:CREATE TABLE doctor_repair_steps (
 repair_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES doctor_repairs(id),
 number INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(number>0),
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN('poll_flag','session_file','worktree_file','run_interrupt','session_unlock','report_completion','watermark_rewind','graph_dispatch_cancel','graph_wait_cancel','graph_attempt_cancel','graph_fail','release_instance','resume_story','park_story','stop_run','requeue_schedule','cancel_schedule','consume_comment','sync_branch')),
 target TEXT NOT NULL,
 before_value TEXT NOT NULL,
 after_value TEXT NOT NULL,
 source_identity TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(state IN('pending','backed_up','write_intent','verified','uncertain')),
 backup BLOB,
 backup_reference TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 backup_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 observed_after TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 PRIMARY KEY(repair_id,number)
)

table:doctor_repairs:CREATE TABLE doctor_repairs (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 source_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 principal TEXT NOT NULL,
 task_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
 conversation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES doctor_conversations(id),
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
 proposal_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES doctor_proposals(id),
 proposal_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 presentation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('reserved','quiescing','backed_up','applying','verifying','needs_review','verified','restart_pending','recovered','stopped','completed','failed')),
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 fenced INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(fenced IN(0,1)),
 exclusion_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 failure TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:doctor_restarts:CREATE TABLE doctor_restarts (
 repair_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES doctor_repairs(id),
 token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN('pending','dispatched','acknowledged','uncertain')),
 old_instance TEXT NOT NULL,
 new_instance TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 report TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:doctor_scans:CREATE TABLE doctor_scans (
 repo_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES repos(id),
 activated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 completed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 window_end TEXT NOT NULL,
 page INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(page>0)
)

table:drift_analyses:CREATE TABLE drift_analyses (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 run_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES drift_analyst_runs(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 repository TEXT NOT NULL,
 request_key TEXT,
 request_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
 version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 execution TEXT NOT NULL,
 record_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(repository,request_key)
)

table:drift_analyst_runs:CREATE TABLE drift_analyst_runs (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id<>''),
 analysis_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES drift_analyses(id),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:drift_evidence:CREATE TABLE drift_evidence (
 analysis_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES drift_analyses(id),
 id TEXT NOT NULL,
 evidence_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(analysis_id,id)
)

table:drift_proposal_links:CREATE TABLE drift_proposal_links (
 analysis_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES drift_analyses(id),
 candidate_key TEXT NOT NULL,
 proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES standards_proposals(id),
 version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(analysis_id,candidate_key)
)

table:drift_receipts:CREATE TABLE drift_receipts (
 analysis_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES drift_analyses(id),
 request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 digest TEXT NOT NULL,
 receipt_json TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(analysis_id,request_id)
)

table:durable_workflow_attempts:CREATE TABLE "durable_workflow_attempts" (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES durable_workflow_jobs(id),
 proposal_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES owner_action_proposals(id), execution_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
 state TEXT NOT NULL, fence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, queued_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 started_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', deadline TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', finished_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 admission_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'confirmed_workflow' CHECK(admission_kind IN ('confirmed_workflow','advisory','brainstorm_scan')),
 advisory_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES advisory_admissions(id),
 brainstorm_scan_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES brainstorm_scans(id),
 CHECK((admission_kind='confirmed_workflow' AND proposal_id IS NOT NULL AND advisory_id IS NULL AND brainstorm_scan_id IS NULL) OR
       (admission_kind='advisory' AND proposal_id IS NULL AND advisory_id IS NOT NULL AND brainstorm_scan_id IS NULL) OR
       (admission_kind='brainstorm_scan' AND proposal_id IS NULL AND advisory_id IS NULL AND brainstorm_scan_id IS NOT NULL))
)

table:durable_workflow_jobs:CREATE TABLE "durable_workflow_jobs" (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, owner_generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
 snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 result TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', questions TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
 domain_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', summary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 admission_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'confirmed_workflow' CHECK(admission_kind IN ('confirmed_workflow','advisory','brainstorm_scan'))
)

table:durable_workflow_notices:CREATE TABLE durable_workflow_notices (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES durable_workflow_jobs(id),
 revision INTEGER NOT NULL, event TEXT NOT NULL, destination TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, message_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 retry_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(job_id,revision,event,destination)
)

table:durable_workflow_requests:CREATE TABLE durable_workflow_requests (
 owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, owner_generation INTEGER NOT NULL, request_key TEXT NOT NULL,
 digest TEXT NOT NULL, proposal_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES owner_action_proposals(id),
 job_id TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, inputs TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL,
 expected_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,owner_generation,request_key)
)

table:durable_workflow_worker:CREATE TABLE durable_workflow_worker (
 singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1), attempt_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', heartbeat_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

table:family_requests:CREATE TABLE family_requests (
    run_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id),
    attempt TEXT NOT NULL,
    request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    repository TEXT NOT NULL,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    tool TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    disposition TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(disposition IN ('pending','rejected','uncertain','confirmed')),
    reference_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    reference_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    reference_request TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    PRIMARY KEY(run_id, attempt, request_id)
)
table:followup_materializations:CREATE TABLE followup_materializations (run_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES validation_assessments(run_id))

table:followup_proposals:CREATE TABLE followup_proposals (
 proposal_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, parent_task TEXT NOT NULL, generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
 run_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES validation_assessments(run_id),
 title TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL,
 approval_comment INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 attachment_comment INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 attach INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, attempted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 issue_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, issue_number INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 attached INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, proposed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 reported INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, diagnostic TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
)

table:graph_attempt_timeouts:CREATE TABLE graph_attempt_timeouts (
 node_attempt_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES graph_node_attempts(id),
 budget_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(budget_seconds>0),
 timed_out_at TEXT NOT NULL
, budget_ns INTEGER)

table:graph_comment_intents:CREATE TABLE graph_comment_intents (
 delivery_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 instance_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES graph_instances(id),
 source_attempt_id INTEGER REFERENCES graph_node_attempts(id),
 node TEXT NOT NULL,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('question','review','final','failure','advisory')),
 candidate BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(candidate) BETWEEN 1 AND 1048576),
 stop_origin TEXT,
 stop_cause TEXT,
 stop_reason TEXT,
 created_at TEXT,
 CHECK(stop_origin IS NULL OR (kind='question' AND length(stop_origin)>0 AND length(stop_cause)>0 AND length(stop_reason)>0)),
 CHECK(source_attempt_id IS NOT NULL OR stop_origin IS NOT NULL)
)

table:graph_definitions:CREATE TABLE graph_definitions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    team TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(team) > 0),
    mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(mode) > 0),
    profile_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (profile_version >= 1),
    path TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(path) > 0),
    digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(digest) = 64),
    team_snapshot_digest TEXT,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL, workflow TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    UNIQUE (team, mode, digest)
)

table:graph_dispatches:CREATE TABLE graph_dispatches (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
 instance_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES graph_instances(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 node TEXT NOT NULL,
 due_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK(status IN ('pending','reserved','running','finished','cancelled')),
 allocated_run_id INTEGER UNIQUE REFERENCES runs(id),
 reserved_at TEXT,
 finished_at TEXT,
 cancellation_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL
, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, launch_id INTEGER REFERENCES research_launch_definitions(id))

table:graph_effects:CREATE TABLE graph_effects (
 operation TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 instance_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES graph_instances(id),
 source_attempt_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES graph_node_attempts(id),
 kind TEXT NOT NULL,
 binding BLOB NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('intent','dispatched','confirmed','uncertain','refused')),
 claim_attempt_id INTEGER REFERENCES graph_node_attempts(id),
 observation BLOB NOT NULL DEFAULT X'',
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:graph_instances:CREATE TABLE graph_instances (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    session_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id),
    definition_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES graph_definitions(id),
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('running','succeeded','failed','cancelled')),
    current_node TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(current_node) > 0),
    next_due_at TEXT,
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    finished_at TEXT,
    CHECK ((status = 'running' AND finished_at IS NULL) OR
           (status <> 'running' AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND next_due_at IS NULL))
)

table:graph_node_attempts:CREATE TABLE graph_node_attempts (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    instance_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES graph_instances(id),
    node TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(node) > 0),
    attempt INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (attempt > 0),
    run_id INTEGER REFERENCES runs(id),
    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending','running','succeeded','failed','cancelled')),
    outcome TEXT,
    started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    finished_at TEXT, launch_id INTEGER REFERENCES research_launch_definitions(id),
    CHECK (outcome IS NULL OR status = 'succeeded'),
    CHECK ((status IN ('pending','running') AND finished_at IS NULL) OR
           (status IN ('succeeded','failed','cancelled') AND finished_at IS NOT NULL)),
    UNIQUE (instance_id, node, attempt)
)

table:graph_outputs:CREATE TABLE graph_outputs (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    node_attempt_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES graph_node_attempts(id),
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('text','json','diagnostic')),
    payload BLOB NOT NULL,
    owner_comment_id INTEGER,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:graph_owner_waits:CREATE TABLE graph_owner_waits (
 delivery_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES graph_comment_intents(delivery_key),
 instance_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES graph_instances(id),
 source_attempt_id INTEGER REFERENCES graph_node_attempts(id),
 state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('waiting','claimed','allocated','cancelled')),
 reply_id INTEGER,
 reply_body TEXT,
 reply_author_id INTEGER,
 claimed_at TEXT,
 continuation_attempt_id INTEGER REFERENCES graph_node_attempts(id),
 origin_node TEXT,
 allow_runless INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(allow_runless IN (0,1)), allowance_attempt_id INTEGER REFERENCES graph_node_attempts(id), reply_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'forge' CHECK(reply_source IN ('forge','chat')), reply_to_comment_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(reply_to_comment_id>=0),
 CHECK(reply_body IS NULL OR length(CAST(reply_body AS BLOB)) <= 65536),
 CHECK(source_attempt_id IS NOT NULL OR (origin_node IS NOT NULL AND length(origin_node)>0)),
 UNIQUE(instance_id,reply_id)
)

table:graph_transitions:CREATE TABLE graph_transitions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    instance_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES graph_instances(id),
    from_node TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(from_node) > 0),
    to_node TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(to_node) > 0),
    on_outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(on_outcome) > 0),
    at TEXT NOT NULL
)

table:identities:CREATE TABLE identities (
    forge      TEXT    NOT NULL,
    role       TEXT    NOT NULL,   -- owner | bot
    handle     TEXT    NOT NULL,   -- display only: handles are renameable
    user_id    INTEGER,            -- numeric forge id; the identity that comparisons use (D-I)
    source     TEXT    NOT NULL,   -- gh for owner, forge-api for bot
    derived_at TEXT    NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (forge, role)
)

table:implement_progress_reports:CREATE TABLE implement_progress_reports (
 id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(id>0),
 parent TEXT NOT NULL,
 generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
 story_key TEXT NOT NULL,
 run_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 attempt TEXT NOT NULL,
 sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence>=1),
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('implementation','testing','repair')),
 message TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(message AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 2048),
 message_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
 story_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(story_attempts>=0),
 recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(run_id,attempt,sequence),

    delivery_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    identity_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (identity_version = 1),
    session_id INTEGER REFERENCES sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    trigger_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (trigger_id >= 0),
    run_id INTEGER REFERENCES runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    task TEXT NOT NULL,
    destination TEXT NOT NULL,
    trigger_namespace TEXT NOT NULL,
    purpose TEXT NOT NULL,
    bot_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (bot_user_id > 0),
    body TEXT NOT NULL,
    marker TEXT NOT NULL,
    possibly_sent INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (possibly_sent IN (0,1)),
    comment_id INTEGER CHECK (comment_id > 0),
    completed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (completed IN (0,1)),
    legacy INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (legacy IN (0,1)),
    doctor_command_id INTEGER REFERENCES doctor_inbox(id),
    doctor_probe_page INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(doctor_probe_page>0), confirmed_at TEXT, confirmed_url TEXT,
    CHECK (comment_id IS NULL OR possibly_sent = 1),
    CHECK (completed = 0 OR comment_id IS NOT NULL),
    CHECK (legacy = 0 OR possibly_sent = 1)
,
 CHECK((session_id IS NOT NULL AND doctor_command_id IS NULL) OR (session_id IS NULL AND run_id IS NULL AND doctor_command_id IS NOT NULL AND trigger_namespace='doctor'))
)

)

table:runs:CREATE TABLE runs (
    id                 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    session_id         INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    segment_id         INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES segments (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    ordinal            INTEGER NOT NULL,   -- per session; the NNNN in the log filename
    mode               TEXT    NOT NULL,   -- spike at M0
    trigger_comment_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status             TEXT    NOT NULL,   -- running | succeeded | failed | reported
    exit_code          INTEGER,            -- NULL while running; -1 for a signal or timeout (S-9)
    error              TEXT,               -- kill/abandon reason accompanying exit_code -1
    started_at         TEXT    NOT NULL,
    finished_at        TEXT,
    duration_ms        INTEGER,
    cost_usd           REAL,               -- from the terminal result event
    log_path           TEXT    NOT NULL,
    commit_sha         TEXT,
    result_comment_id  INTEGER, agent TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'claude', sync_outcome TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', sync_behind INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, sync_ahead INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, sync_commit_sha TEXT, semantic_outcome TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', recovery_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', sync_observations TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', published INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, publication TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', workflow TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(workflow IN ('','bug')), preparation_caveats TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',            -- NULL until the report is posted
    -- One comment can cause at most one run, ever. This is the constraint the
    -- whole crash-replay story rests on (AC-3.4, AC-2.21, AC-4.10).
    UNIQUE (session_id, trigger_comment_id),
    UNIQUE (session_id, ordinal)
)

 CHECK((family = 'standalone' AND workflow = 'bug') OR (family = 'mode' AND workflow <> 'bug'))
)

trigger:drift_evidence_immutable:CREATE TRIGGER drift_evidence_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON drift_evidence
WHEN NOT (
 OLD.analysis_id IS NEW.analysis_id AND OLD.id IS NEW.id
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM drift_analyses WHERE id=OLD.analysis_id AND execution<>'running')
 AND json_extract(OLD.evidence_json,'$.excerpt_expired') IS NOT 1
 AND json_extract(NEW.evidence_json,'$.excerpt_expired') IS 1
 AND json_extract(NEW.evidence_json,'$.text') IS ''
 AND COALESCE(json_extract(NEW.evidence_json,'$.excerpt_bytes'),0) IS length(CAST(json_extract(OLD.evidence_json,'$.text') AS BLOB))
 AND json_extract(NEW.evidence_json,'$.omission') IS CASE WHEN COALESCE(json_extract(OLD.evidence_json,'$.omission'),'')='' THEN 'retained excerpt expired' ELSE json_extract(OLD.evidence_json,'$.omission')||'; retained excerpt expired' END
 AND json_remove(NEW.evidence_json,'$.text','$.omission','$.excerpt_expired','$.excerpt_bytes') IS json_remove(OLD.evidence_json,'$.text','$.omission','$.excerpt_expired','$.excerpt_bytes')
)
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable drift evidence'); END

 WHEN OLD.caller_kind<>NEW.caller_kind OR OLD.graph_instance_id IS NOT NEW.graph_instance_id
 OR OLD.judge_node_attempt_id IS NOT NEW.judge_node_attempt_id OR OLD.source_node<>NEW.source_node
 OR OLD.source_node_attempt_id IS NOT NEW.source_node_attempt_id OR OLD.source_json<>NEW.source_json
 OR OLD.configuration<>NEW.configuration OR OLD.evidence<>NEW.evidence
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'immutable judge request binding'); END

trigger:workflow_judge_binding_insert:CREATE TRIGGER workflow_judge_binding_insert BEFORE INSERT ON judge_requests
 WHEN (NEW.caller_kind='workflow' AND NOT EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM graph_node_attempts j JOIN graph_instances i ON i.id=j.instance_id JOIN graph_node_attempts s ON s.instance_id=i.id
 WHERE i.id=NEW.graph_instance_id AND i.session_id=NEW.session_id AND j.id=NEW.judge_node_attempt_id AND j.status='running'
 AND s.id=NEW.source_node_attempt_id AND s.node=NEW.source_node AND s.status='succeeded'))
 OR (NEW.caller_kind='manual' AND (NEW.graph_instance_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.judge_node_attempt_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.source_node_attempt_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.source_node<>''))
 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'workflow judge binding mismatch'); END

view:doctor_held_session_owners:CREATE VIEW doctor_held_session_owners AS
SELECT s.id AS session_id,h.repair_id
FROM sessions s JOIN doctor_repair_holds h ON h.active=1
WHERE s.task_ref=h.task_ref
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM managed_stories m WHERE m.parent_task=s.task_ref AND h.task_ref=substr(m.parent_task,1,instr(m.parent_task,'#'))||m.issue_number)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM plan_story_drafts p WHERE p.parent=s.task_ref AND h.task_ref=substr(p.parent,1,instr(p.parent,'#'))||p.issue_number)
